messages: maria (infra): Heads-up: eu-west2 ephemeral nodes hit a cascading I/O issue. Janitor cleanup + tiny-file churn amplified into NVMe queue exhaustion and blocked gpu attaches. ops-bot: alert fired: /alerts/ephemeral-iops-spike eu-west2 (iops ~5x baseline). maria (infra): timeline: 03:10 janitor started aggressive sweep, 03:14 iops ramp, 03:16 gpu attach errors. leo (sre): attach logs show 'device busy: nvme queue depth exhausted'. can we see current janitor config? ashwin (eng-infra): scrub cadence changed in recent deploy (PR #4532) 1 aggressive window set to 5m to reduce batch latency. likely too aggressive. sophie (oncall): impact: ~12 pending gpu attaches, 3 failed job retries, provisioning cost spike from retries. maria (infra): mitigation request: pause janitor for eu-west pools for 30m? janitor-bot: pausing janitor for label=ephemeral-eu-west2 by request of maria (infra). ashwin (eng-infra): applying soft pause on canaries; rolling scrub cadence back to 20m. command used: `kubectl -n infra patch cronjob janitor-cleaner --patch '{"spec":{"schedule":"*/20 * * * *"}}'`. leo (sre): throttling host NVMe submission (`echo 64 > /sys/block/nvme0/queue/nr_requests`) on three affected hosts, doing one-at-a-time with kernel-safe window. ops-bot: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ephemeral-iops?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west2 shows prefix write spike. sophie (oncall): should we cordon nodes to free pressure before attach drains? maria (infra): avoid cordons if we can - prefer pause + timeout bump. ashwin (eng-infra): bumping provisioner attachTimeout 30s -> 90s. snippet: `provisioner.attachTimeoutSeconds: 90`. leo (sre): smartctl OK, wear% steady 1 indicates load pattern, not failing drives. maria (infra): root cause: janitor scheduling + tiny-delete metadata storm -> NVMe qdepth exhaust -> attach fails. ashwin (eng-infra): long-term: janitor should be size-aware, exponential backoff if iops > threshold, and add tempfile-churn metric. sophie (oncall): tweak alerting: only page when scrub spike correlates with attach failures. ops-bot: runbook link /runbooks/io-snowball-ephemeral.md (draft) added. leo (sre): current status: janitor paused, attach timeout increased, host throttle applied on 3 nodes, attach backlog draining, iops down to ~1.4x baseline. maria (infra): thanks 1 follow-ups: canary janitor with iops guard, metrics for tempfile churn, postmortem if repeats. ashwin (eng-infra): opening ticket INFRA-2741 (janitor rate-limit + iops safety). sophie (oncall): tagging product & finance for cost impact. maria (infra): set cost flag for retry charges -> bill center infra-ops. leo (sre): syslog snippet for context: `Mar 25 03:16 gnode-128 provisioner[2123]: attach failed: rpc timeout, nvme io wait high; Mar 25 03:16 gnode-128 kernel: nvme0: submission queue full, qdepth=1024`. maria (infra): closing immediate incident 1 reopen if iops > 2x baseline. :white_check_mark:
